goal: Author the offline test execution harness in __agentic/v2/tests/conftest.py to enforce zero-network testing with an in-process socket connection trap in pytest_sessionstart intercepting socket.socket.connect with RuntimeError('Network access forbidden in offline test harness'), and enforce sandbox isolation using pytest tmp_path fixtures for all temporary SQLite database and filesystem artifacts to strictly prevent triggering the repository-root physics wall sandbox guard or mutating production systems.

acceptance_criteria.statement: AC-24: Test module imports no top-level network client libraries (docker, requests, httpx, aiohttp, urllib.request); session socket guard intercepts network connect calls and raises RuntimeError('Network access forbidden in offline test harness').

AC-36: Deliberate positive socket guard test: calling socket.socket().connect(('1.1.1.1', 80)) explicitly raises RuntimeError('Network access forbidden in offline test harness'), verifying socket connection trap is actively intercepting outbound connections.

AC-39: Test suite executes exclusively within isolated tmp_path fixtures for SQLite and filesystem artifacts, strictly preventing any trigger of the repository-root [HARD ABORT: PHYSICS WALL] sandbox guard and preventing mutation of production assets.

test_cases.name: test_no_network_no_daemon
test_cases.asserts: Statically inspects test modules via AST parsing to verify no top-level network libraries (docker, requests, httpx, aiohttp, urllib.request) are imported, ensuring zero network dependencies in test definitions.

test_cases.name: test_socket_guard_active
test_cases.asserts: Directly attempts socket.socket().connect(('1.1.1.1', 80)) and asserts that RuntimeError is raised with message 'Network access forbidden in offline test harness', confirming socket guard interception is active.

test_cases.name: test_sandbox_isolation_preflight
test_cases.asserts: Asserts that test execution and filesystem artifacts are strictly confined to tmp_path fixtures without accessing or mutating repository root production files (cochem_kanban.db or .scripts), preventing trigger of the repository root sandbox guard.

out_of_scope: Modification of legacy v1 production files (D:\__CoChem\cochem_kanban.db, D:\__CoChem\.scripts)
Implementation of Phase 2 runtime application daemons (task_work_loop_v2.py, cochem_kanban_mcp_v2.py, watchdog_v2.py)
Live Docker container builds, Docker Compose execution, or requirement of an active Docker daemon
Outbound network access, live remote LLM inference, or remote PyPI downloads
Authoring or modifying Phase 1 deliverables outside conftest.py (Dockerfile, docker-compose.yml, schema_v2.sql, init_db.py)
risks: In-process socket connection trap blocking stdlib internal loopback connections required by test runner plugins unless loopback is properly handled
Pytest conftest hook pytest_sessionstart execution order: ensuring socket patch is installed before any test module or fixture imports trigger socket operations
Accidental file creation or database connection outside tmp_path triggering repository root sandbox guard or physics wall abort
